answer_1.quote: The reasoning module is simply implemented by calling an off-the-shelf model to generate the answer
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to multimodal multi-hop questions

answer_2.quote: The answers are evaluated using the F1 and exact match (EM) scores. The evaluation metrics for WebQA involve QA-Acc, keyword-based accuracy and QA-FL, which assesses fluency using BARTScore.
